global.asf-data-search.name: ASF Data Search (Vertex)
global.asf-data-search.summary: Main archive for SAR data: Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR, NISAR and on-demand InSAR/RTC processing; free Earthdata Login needed.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: Per mission (Sentinel-1: Copernicus open licence; NASA data public domain)

global.aws-open-data-registry.name: Registry of Open Data on AWS
global.aws-open-data-registry.summary: Directory of 600+ public datasets in S3 (Sentinel, Landsat, NAIP, Copernicus DEM, ERA5, NOAA), free to access without an account.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: Per dataset

global.copernicus-data-space-ecosystem.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
global.copernicus-data-space-ecosystem.summary: Official free access to the full Sentinel-1, -2, -3 and -5P archives (10–300 m) with STAC, OData, openEO and S3 APIs; free account needed for downloads.

global.digital-earth-africa.name: Digital Earth Africa
global.digital-earth-africa.summary: Analysis-ready Landsat and Sentinel data for Africa plus derived products (water observations, cropland extent, coastlines) on AWS.
global.digital-earth-africa.attribution: Digital Earth Africa (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data)

global.earth-search-stac-api.name: Earth Search STAC API
global.earth-search-stac-api.summary: Free, no-login STAC search over Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, Landsat Collection 2, Sentinel-1 GRD and Copernicus DEM on AWS; used in our Lake Mead tutorial.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: Per collection (Sentinel: Copernicus open licence; Landsat: public domain)

global.eox-sentinel-2-cloudless.name: EOxCloudless Sentinel-2 mosaics
global.eox-sentinel-2-cloudless.summary: Cloud-free 10 m true-colour Sentinel-2 mosaics of the whole world for each year since 2016, as free WMTS basemaps.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: CC BY 4.0 (2016 mosaic); CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (2018 and later)

global.google-earth-engine-catalog.name: Google Earth Engine Data Catalog
global.google-earth-engine-catalog.summary: Catalogue of 1,000+ public raster and vector datasets; analysis runs in Earth Engine, which requires a registered Cloud project.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: Per dataset; Earth Engine free for non-commercial use, paid for commercial

global.landsat-missions.name: Landsat Missions
global.landsat-missions.summary: 30 m multispectral imagery since 1972 (Landsat 1–9); Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance is the usual starting point.

global.maxar-open-data.name: Maxar Open Data Program
global.maxar-open-data.summary: Pre- and post-event very-high-resolution (about 30–50 cm) imagery for major disasters, released for humanitarian response.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: CC BY-NC 4.0

global.microsoft-planetary-computer.name: Microsoft Planetary Computer
global.microsoft-planetary-computer.summary: Over 100 analysis-ready datasets (Sentinel, Landsat, NAIP, ERA5, land cover) behind a free STAC API; data access needs no account.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: Per dataset (mostly open; shown on each collection page)

global.nasa-earthdata.name: NASA Earthdata Search
global.nasa-earthdata.summary: Search and download the full NASA EOSDIS archive (MODIS, VIIRS, SRTM, ICESat-2, GEDI, SMAP); downloads need a free Earthdata Login.

global.nasa-jpl-emit.name: EMIT imaging spectrometer and methane plumes
global.nasa-jpl-emit.summary: Hyperspectral imaging spectrometer on the International Space Station; JPL publishes mineral dust maps, methane and CO2 enhancement images and a catalogue of detected plume complexes, with an interactive greenhouse gas data portal.

global.nasa-worldview.name: NASA Worldview
global.nasa-worldview.summary: Daily global MODIS and VIIRS imagery within hours of capture, with 1,000+ layers back to 2000; ideal for fires, floods and dust.

global.openaerialmap.name: OpenAerialMap
global.openaerialmap.summary: Openly licensed drone and aerial imagery contributed by the community, often at a few centimetres resolution; coverage is patchy.

global.sentinel-hub-eo-browser.name: Sentinel Hub EO Browser
global.sentinel-hub-eo-browser.summary: Quick visual search of Sentinel, Landsat and MODIS archives with custom scripts and time-lapse export; free account required.

useStatus.restricted: Terms not reviewed for use in a paid app: Per collection (Sentinel and Landsat open; free account)

global.usgs-earthexplorer.name: USGS EarthExplorer
global.usgs-earthexplorer.summary: Search and order Landsat, Sentinel-2, SRTM, aerial photography and declassified satellite imagery; free USGS login needed to download.

layers.name: Africa: Digital Earth Africa
layers.summary: Annual GeoMAD (Sentinel-2) cloud-free true-colour composite, 2025 (default; 2017-2025 via TIME).
